name: Merge Small Chunks
description: Merge consecutive small fragments into larger chunks up to a target size.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Raw text input to normalize into mergeable chunks.

inputs.name: documents
inputs.description: Optional document stream to normalize into chunks before merging.

parameters.name: target_chunk_size
parameters.description: Target merged chunk size in the selected unit.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: Sizing unit for target_chunk_size and max_chunk_size.

parameters.name: max_chunk_size
parameters.description: Optional hard limit. Use 0 to disable.

parameters.name: merge_strategy
parameters.description: Sequential emits when target is met; greedy emits when adding another fragment would worsen fit.

parameters.name: preserve_boundaries
parameters.description: Preserve visible boundaries between merged fragments.
